prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV tanning beds/booths or spray (airbrush) tanning? I can give specific salon recommendations if you tell me which type you want — or your zip/postal code or part of Pleasanton you’re near.

While you decide, here’s how to pick the “best” salon and a few safety/use tips:

How to choose the right salon
- Check recent reviews on Google and Yelp for cleanliness, customer service, and consistent results. Prioritize places with many recent 4–5 star reviews.
- Verify staff training and certifications (especially for spray tanning — look for certified technicians).
- Inspect equipment: for UV tanning, ask how often bulbs are replaced and whether beds/booths are cleaned between customers.
- Ask about pricing and packages, membership commitments, and cancellation policies.
- For spray tans, request a patch test and a portfolio or before/after photos of recent clients with similar skin tones.
- Look for proper ventilation and hygiene (disposable nose plugs, hairnets, clean gowns).

Safety & quality tips
- If using UV beds: limit frequency, follow recommended exposure times for your skin type, and always use goggles.
- For spray tans: exfoliate and moisturize beforehand, follow aftercare (avoid sweating, shower timing) to get an even fade.
- Consider non-UV alternatives (spray tans, self-tanners) to reduce skin cancer and aging risks.

If you want, tell me “UV” or “spray” and your neighborhood/zip code and I’ll pull together a short list of top-rated salons and contact details.
